_meta.title: iPhone Duo physical reference spec for 3D modeling
notes: This file complements, and does not repeat, duo/research/2026-09-23-device-geometry-and-mockups.md, which covers display point sizes, corner radii of the DISPLAYS, safe areas, and poses.

Values marked source 'Apple AR USDZ (own measurement)' were derived by the author of this file by importing Apple's own published iPhone_Duo_e-sim_Star-White_Variant.usdz AR Quick Look model into Blender 4.5/5.2 (bpy.ops.wm.usd_import) and reading mesh vertex world-space bounding boxes and face normals with a Python script. Node names inside the USDZ are randomized/obfuscated (no semantic labels), so which mesh is which physical part is an inference from size, position, and material clustering, not a label Apple provides. Confidence is set accordingly.

The USDZ model's own pose is NOT flat-open and NOT fully closed: it is closed with the hinge cracked open a small amount (a common AR/marketing hero pose). Excluding a low-poly invisible bounding/interaction proxy mesh, the visible geometry's plan-view footprint (85.22 x 118.40 mm) matches Apple's published CLOSED footprint (84.1 x 117.8 mm) to about 1 mm, but the thickness axis (16.73 mm) reads well above the published closed depth (11.3 mm) because the halves are slightly splayed. Treat any thickness/angle number from this asset with low confidence; treat plan-view (width/height) positions of parts on either shell as medium confidence.

SHA-256 of the analyzed USDZ: 5cab2ea636da0bc0b06c8abf4809843498f7c1d680042b4f95e383b5c6a718b2. This matches the file independently archived and measured by the community project agarwalmukul/iPhoneDuo, whose published measurements (lens spacing 17.77 mm, lens-ring diameter 16.25 mm, per-leaf chassis 82.45 x 117.95 mm) match this file's own Blender measurements exactly, cross-validating the method.

Reviewer pass (2026-09-23): the USDZ has variant sets Pose {Closed, Landscape} and Color {Night_Sky, Star_White}. Pose=Landscape is flat open and true to scale (leaves 2 x 82.45 x 117.95 mm vs spec 164.6 x 117.8). Pose=Closed is flush closed, not cracked open: its 16.73 mm depth is the 11.0 mm body stack plus the camera bump. Values below labeled 'reviewer pass' come from these variants; part identities are inferred from size, position, and material.

plan_view_footprint_closed_measured.note: Includes button and hinge-cover protrusions. The chassis leaf alone is 82.45 x 117.95 mm.

corner_radius_plan_view.source: Derived (reviewer pass): display corner radius in mm plus the measured border, assuming concentric corners
corner_radius_plan_view.note: Display radii from the simulator profile (outer 59 pt free / 8 pt hinge, inner 55 pt) at 6.02 pt/mm (466 pt / 77.39 mm). Outer: 9.80 + 2.72 = 12.52 mm; inner: 9.14 + 3.46 = 12.60 mm. The two agree, which supports concentricity. Hinge side: 1.33 + 2.34 = 3.67 mm.

edge_profile.value: flat chamfer band transitioning to a rounded side wall
edge_profile.source: Apple newsroom hinge/edge close-up photo (newsroom_hinge_closeup_2x.jpg) and design_hero images
edge_profile.note: Own visual read of official photography: each half shows a bright flat reflective chamfer facet along the top edge, then curves down into the side wall, similar to the flat-sided, chamfered-edge language Apple used starting with iPhone 12/16-series titanium frames. No numeric chamfer width or wall radius is published.

frame_around_outer_display.source: Derived: (84.1-77.2)/2 approx per side using published outer active area
frame_around_outer_display.note: Duplicated from the companion geometry note for convenience; see that note for the outer/inner active-area derivation.

outer_display_half_thickness.source: Apple AR USDZ, Pose variant 'Landscape' (flat) or 'Closed', measured with usd-core (reviewer pass)
outer_display_half_thickness.note: Chassis leaf in Pose=Closed, z 0.47..5.50; equal to the other leaf.

inner_display_half_thickness.source: Apple AR USDZ, Pose variant 'Landscape' (flat) or 'Closed', measured with usd-core (reviewer pass)
inner_display_half_thickness.note: Chassis leaf in Pose=Closed, z -5.50..-0.47. In Landscape, leaf plus inner display surface = 5.23 mm (spec 5.2).

per_leaf_chassis_footprint_measured.source: Apple AR USDZ (own measurement); cross-checked exactly against agarwalmukul/iPhoneDuo docs/apple-model-comparison.md
per_leaf_chassis_footprint_measured.note: [width, height] of a single leaf's exterior shell mesh in the USDZ. Slightly larger than the published closed footprint (84.1 x 117.8 mm total, i.e. this is not simply half); this is the shell's own modeled footprint including its curled edge, not a device-level spec.

outer_display_active_area.source: Apple AR USDZ, Pose variant 'Landscape' (flat) or 'Closed', measured with usd-core (reviewer pass)
outer_display_active_area.note: Outer display mesh; matches the 77.2 x 112.3 derivation from pixels and ppi.

outer_display_borders.source: Apple AR USDZ, Pose variant 'Landscape' (flat) or 'Closed', measured with usd-core (reviewer pass)
outer_display_borders.note: Distance from the leaf edge to the outer display's active area.

inner_display_active_area.source: Apple AR USDZ, Pose variant 'Landscape' (flat) or 'Closed', measured with usd-core (reviewer pass)
inner_display_active_area.note: Centered on the open device; matches the 157.7 x 110.9 derivation.

inner_display_border.source: Apple AR USDZ, Pose variant 'Landscape' (flat) or 'Closed', measured with usd-core (reviewer pass)
inner_display_border.note: Uniform on all four sides of the open device.

outer_display_leaf.value: x < 0 in Landscape (the left half seen from the inner display)
outer_display_leaf.source: Apple AR USDZ, Pose variant 'Landscape' (flat) or 'Closed', measured with usd-core (reviewer pass)
outer_display_leaf.note: The outer display is on the back of the LEFT half; the rear camera is on the back of the RIGHT half.

component_count.note: "engineered from more than 100 components to precisely control opening and closing and support the center of the display".

closure_mechanism.note: "together with an integrated magnet array, delivers a satisfying and secure closure."

hinge_cover_material_finish.value: 3D-printed titanium hinge cover, micro-blasted finish (contrasts with the mirror-polished body)
hinge_cover_material_finish.note: Direct quote: "a 3D-printed hinge cover with a contrasting micro-blasted finish."

flat_when_open.note: "it supports the center of the display to hold it flat when opened".

gap_when_closed.source: Apple AR USDZ, Pose variant 'Landscape' (flat) or 'Closed', measured with usd-core (reviewer pass)
gap_when_closed.note: Gap between the two parallel leaves in Pose=Closed (z -0.47..0.47); the folded inner display bulges into the hinge region (z +/-1.23).

fold_cycle_rating.note: Apple does not publish a fold-cycle count (noted explicitly by androidheadlines.com's hands-on, which contrasts this with Samsung's published 500,000-fold rating for the Galaxy Z Fold8).

internal_reinforcement.value: support ribs for added stiffness; antenna splits with ceramic fiber inserts

hinge_axis_offset_from_center_measured.note: A long hinge-barrel-like mesh (MvKPXGSdYDVvSpk: 2.90 x 8.20 x 115.58 mm) sits at x = -41.95 mm from the model's origin, i.e. almost exactly half the published closed width (84.1 / 2 = 42.05 mm), running nearly the full 117.8 mm height. Own inference of hinge barrel identity from geometry, not an Apple label.

crease_visibility.value: present but subtle when viewed straight-on; visible at an angle or under direct light
crease_visibility.source: Multiple Sept 2026 hands-on reports (Dave2D via pasqualepillitteri.it, MacRumors, HardwareZone Singapore, Mark Ellis Reviews)
crease_visibility.note: One outlet (9to5google) rated it as visible 'just as much as' Samsung's Fold 8; most others rated it noticeably better hidden thanks to the nano-texture inner display finish.

closed_body_stack.source: Apple AR USDZ, Pose variant 'Landscape' (flat) or 'Closed', measured with usd-core (reviewer pass)
closed_body_stack.note: Two 5.03 mm leaves plus the gap; spec says 11.3 mm.

hinge_core_width.source: Apple AR USDZ, Pose variant 'Landscape' (flat) or 'Closed', measured with usd-core (reviewer pass)
hinge_core_width.note: Mesh centered on the fold line (x -4.11..4.11), full height. Identity inferred.

fold_zone_band_width.source: Apple AR USDZ, Pose variant 'Landscape' (flat) or 'Closed', measured with usd-core (reviewer pass)
fold_zone_band_width.note: Mesh centered on the fold line (x -11.89..11.89) just under the inner display surface; likely the display support in the fold zone. Identity inferred.

inner_nano_texture.value: custom polymer nano-textured cover layer, up to 40% higher stiffness than industry-standard materials, plus a separate scratch-resistant coating
inner_nano_texture.note: Purpose stated by Apple: reduces glare/reflections and minimizes crease visibility; described by MacRumors hands-on as a 'micro lens texture written pixel by pixel using maskless laser lithography'. That fabrication detail is tier F (MacRumors), not confirmed by Apple's own text.

inner_panel_stack.value: high-strength glass above and below the flexible OLED panel, custom adhesives allowing the layers to glide like pages of a book, titanium plate at the bottom
inner_panel_stack.note: Relevant to modeling the fold band's cross-section, not to any single published thickness figure.

outer_cover_glass.value: Ceramic Shield 2, 3x better scratch resistance than the previous generation, reduces glare
outer_cover_glass.source: Apple newsroom and apple.com/iphone-duo/specs/ ('Ceramic Shield 2 front')

back_cover_glass.source: Apple newsroom and specs page ('Ceramic Shield back')

front_facing_camera_outer.value: visible circular cutout, top-right corner of the outer display
front_facing_camera_outer.note: Own visual read; matches HIG diagram description already covered in the companion geometry note.

front_facing_camera_inner.value: hidden under-display FaceTime camera, invisible when not in use
front_facing_camera_inner.source: Apple newsroom: 'a new FaceTime camera stays hidden when not in use to keep the screen uninterrupted'
front_facing_camera_inner.note: No cutout to model when the inner display is treated as active; model as an under-panel component only.

rear_camera_count.source: Apple newsroom ('48MP Fusion Main' + '48MP Fusion Ultra Wide'); Apple AR USDZ (own measurement found exactly two lens-ring mesh clusters)
rear_camera_count.note: The newsroom copy's '2x Telephoto' is an optical-quality digital crop of the 48MP Fusion Main sensor, not a third physical lens; this is corroborated by the USDZ geometry, which has only two lens-sized circular mesh clusters.

rear_camera_arrangement.value: side-by-side horizontal pair on the back of the half OPPOSITE the outer display (the right half in the open view), near the top edge and the free edge
rear_camera_arrangement.source: Apple official image highlights_camera_2x.jpg / newsroom_colors_2x.jpg; Apple AR USDZ (own measurement)
rear_camera_arrangement.note: Corrected in reviewer pass: the earlier text said the outer-display half, which the USDZ contradicts.

rear_lens_spacing_center_to_center.source: Apple AR USDZ (own measurement); exact match to agarwalmukul/iPhoneDuo's independent measurement of the same file
rear_lens_spacing_center_to_center.note: Two independent measurements of the same official asset agree exactly.

rear_lens_ring_outer_diameter.source: Apple AR USDZ (own measurement); exact match to agarwalmukul/iPhoneDuo
rear_lens_ring_outer_diameter.note: Outer chrome bezel/ring diameter of each lens, not the glass element diameter.

rear_camera_position_from_top_edge_measu.source: Apple AR USDZ, Pose variant 'Landscape' (flat) or 'Closed', measured with usd-core (reviewer pass)
rear_camera_position_from_top_edge_measu.note: Center of the lens nearer the free edge, from the top edge.

rear_camera_position_from_free_edge_meas.source: Apple AR USDZ, Pose variant 'Landscape' (flat) or 'Closed', measured with usd-core (reviewer pass)
rear_camera_position_from_free_edge_meas.note: Center of the lens nearer the free edge; the other lens center is 33.06 mm from the free edge.

flash.value: single small circular element, up and to the right of the lens pair
flash.source: Apple official image highlights_camera_2x.jpg; a matching small circular mesh cluster (~6 mm) found near the lenses in the USDZ
flash.note: Apple's newsroom text does not name a flash explicitly; identification is from the official photo plus geometry, not an Apple label.

camera_bump_housing.value: single rounded rectangle / pill-shaped raised chrome-rimmed plate enclosing both lenses and the flash
camera_bump_housing.note: Qualitative shape only; footprint and protrusion height could not be reliably isolated from the USDZ mesh (see _meta note on pose) and are not published, so no numeric value is given.

camera_bump_footprint.source: Apple AR USDZ, Pose variant 'Landscape' (flat) or 'Closed', measured with usd-core (reviewer pass)
camera_bump_footprint.note: Raised plateau, x 21.72..77.51, y 92.09..113.24: 4.94 mm from the free edge, 4.71 mm from the top edge, 21.72 mm from the hinge edge.

camera_bump_protrusion.source: Apple AR USDZ, Pose variant 'Landscape' (flat) or 'Closed', measured with usd-core (reviewer pass)
camera_bump_protrusion.note: Heights above the back surface (z -2.74) in Pose=Landscape.

flash_candidate.source: Apple AR USDZ, Pose variant 'Landscape' (flat) or 'Closed', measured with usd-core (reviewer pass)
flash_candidate.note: Round element on the plateau, on the hinge side of the lenses. Identity inferred.

side_button_touch_id.value: elongated pill button on the free (right) edge, integrates Touch ID
side_button_touch_id.source: Apple newsroom ('Touch ID is integrated into the side button'); Apple specs external-connectors diagram aria-label; official images
side_button_touch_id.note: Exact position along the edge (distance from top/bottom) is not published; own visual read from specs_external_connectors_2x.jpg places it above Camera Control, both roughly in the upper-middle third of the free edge.

camera_control.value: second, shorter pill button below the side button on the free (right) edge
camera_control.source: Apple newsroom; specs page aria-label; official images

volume_buttons.value: two separate buttons on the top edge (folded orientation), toward one side
volume_buttons.source: Apple specs page aria-label: 'iPhone Duo, top exterior, folded: built-in stereo speaker, volume up and down'
volume_buttons.note: Exact spacing/position not published; companion geometry note's simulator-derived button order should be treated as the best available secondary estimate.

usb_c_port.value: bottom edge (folded orientation), centered between two microphone holes
usb_c_port.source: Apple specs page aria-label: 'iPhone Duo, bottom exterior, folded: USB-C connector, built-in microphones, built-in stereo speaker'; official specs_external_connectors_2x.jpg diagram

speakers.value: built-in stereo speaker, with grille perforations on both the top and bottom folded edges
speakers.source: Apple specs page aria-label (both top and bottom exterior mentions 'built-in stereo speaker')

microphones.value: built-in microphones, holes visible on the bottom folded edge in the diagram; the unfolded/interior-display view also calls out a built-in microphone

apple_pencil_support.value: Apple Pencil with USB-C, usable on either display, supported later in the year (not at launch)
apple_pencil_support.note: Software/accessory feature, not a physical port; included because it implies no dedicated Pencil garage or magnetic attach point is described.

no_face_id.source: Companion geometry note / absence of any Face ID mention in Apple's Duo materials
no_face_id.note: Authentication is Touch ID only, via the side button.

side_button_geometry.source: Apple AR USDZ, Pose variant 'Landscape' (flat) or 'Closed', measured with usd-core (reviewer pass)

camera_control_geometry.source: Apple AR USDZ, Pose variant 'Landscape' (flat) or 'Closed', measured with usd-core (reviewer pass)

volume_buttons_geometry.source: Apple AR USDZ, Pose variant 'Landscape' (flat) or 'Closed', measured with usd-core (reviewer pass)

usb_c_geometry.source: Apple AR USDZ, Pose variant 'Landscape' (flat) or 'Closed', measured with usd-core (reviewer pass)
usb_c_geometry.note: Centered on its leaf; the housing mesh is larger than the port opening.

bottom_grilles_geometry.source: Apple AR USDZ, Pose variant 'Landscape' (flat) or 'Closed', measured with usd-core (reviewer pass)
bottom_grilles_geometry.note: Speaker and microphone grilles mirrored on both leaves. Identity inferred.

sim.note: Not identified in the checked sources; recent iPhones sold in the US are eSIM-only, which would explain the absence of a tray in the diagrams checked, but this was not explicitly confirmed for iPhone Duo in the sources opened this session.

frame.source: Apple newsroom: 'crafted from grade 5 titanium... an elegant mirror-polished finish'

hinge_cover.value: 3D-printed titanium, micro-blasted finish (contrast to the mirror-polished frame)

inner_display_cover.value: custom nano-textured polymer cover layer over high-strength glass, plus a separate scratch-resistant coating

water_dust_resistance.value: IP68, max depth 6 m up to 30 minutes, IEC 60529

internal_thermal.value: custom-designed vapor chamber, A20 Pro, dual-battery architecture
internal_thermal.note: Not externally visible; included for completeness since the design brief mentions internals imagery.

swatch_hex.note: This is Apple's own small-swatch UI color for the color picker, not a colorimetric measurement of the physical titanium.

photo_sampled_hex_range.source: Own pixel sampling of newsroom_colors_2x.jpg (median of 20x20 px patches at 3 flat, non-specular, non-logo points on the back panel, using Python/Pillow)
photo_sampled_hex_range.note: One sampled point fell in a deep-shadow/specular area and read near-black (#0a131c); excluded as unrepresentative. The mid-range sampled values bracket the CSS swatch value closely, cross-validating it.

photo_sampled_hex_range.source: Own pixel sampling of newsroom_colors_2x.jpg (same method as night_sky)
photo_sampled_hex_range.note: One point near a bottom-edge shadow read darker (#d1cecb) and was excluded as unrepresentative.

finish_note.value: Both colorways share the same mirror-polished titanium frame; only the back Ceramic Shield panel color differs. The frame itself is not a flat color: it is a high-specular mirror finish and should be modeled with a reflective/metallic material and an environment map rather than a single base color.
finish_note.source: Apple newsroom + own observation of official photography
